integrity: The general theorem is proved using integral prescribed-outdegree orientation and cut inequalities; a standard-library verification program and its output are supplied. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: For odd-order regular tournaments and ordinary labeled-edge direction queries; no Littlestone dimension or even-order semiregular result. Finite checks at orders 3 and 5 are independent corroboration but not an infinite proof. Exact historical priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp VC dimension and unique maximum shattered edge sets for regular tournaments
